uutiset.t: Lammens howler denies Man Utd victory against Sporting in incident-packed game
uutiset.s: Goalkeeper Senne Lammens endures a topsy-turvy night as Manchester United draw with Sporting.controversial decisions.

uutiset.t: PSG held by Roma as in-form Malen scores again
uutiset.s: Donyell Malen scores for the fourth Champions League game running as Roma ends Paris St-Germain's 100% start to the competition.

uutiset.t: Terrible Pavlovic own goal gifts Lille shock win against Bayern
uutiset.s: Bayern Munich suffer their first defeat of the Champions League campaign as Lille find the net twice in three minutes in the second half, including a comical Aleksander Pavlovic own goal, to inflict a huge upset.

uutiset.t: Isak scores twice as clinical Liverpool beat Brugge
uutiset.s: Liverpool defeat Club Brugge in a clinical performance thanks to goals from Alexander Isak and Florian Wirtz, bouncing back after a defeat in their last Champions League match.

uutiset.t: Farrell picks side to 'back up' South Africa win
uutiset.s: Ireland head coach Andy Farrell believes the Nations Championship can be good preparation for next year's World Cup.

uutiset.t: Gordon stars in comfortable Barca win over Sabah
uutiset.s: Anthony Gordon scores Barcelona's opening two goals as they ease past Sabah with a 4-1 win in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Borussia Dortmund fight back to draw with Arsenal
uutiset.s: Borussia Dortmund fight back from a goal behind to draw with Arsenal in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Blunt Villa beaten by late Galatasaray winner
uutiset.s: Deniz Gul scores a late winner for Galatasaray as Aston Villa slip to successive Champions League defeats.

uutiset.t: Cherki rescues point for Man City against Napoli
uutiset.s: Rayan Cherki's late equaliser rescues a point for Manchester City at home to Napoli in the Champions League, who have now won just one of their past seven games in all competitions.

uutiset.t: Real Madrid put in five-star second half to win against PSV
uutiset.s: Jude Bellingham comes off the bench to score a stunning goal as Real Madrid come from behind to beat PSV Eindhoven and maintain their 100% record in the Champions League.

uutiset.t: Cordina to face Lara on Joshua-Fury card
uutiset.s: Joe Cordina will face former world champion Mauricio Lara on the undercard of Tyson Fury versus Anthony Joshua in Cardiff next month.

uutiset.t: Regulator chief 'has stomach' to face Man City
uutiset.s: The chair of English football's independent regulator tells MPs he "has the stomach" to take potential action against Manchester City.

uutiset.t: Liverpool mull Quansah return - Thursday's gossip
uutiset.s: Liverpool consider return for Jarrell Quansah, Tottenham scout Vangelis Pavlidis and Paris St-Germain target Estevao Willian, plus more

uutiset.t: Dubois to defend title against Parker in Manchester
uutiset.s: WBO heavyweight world champion Daniel Dubois will make the second defence of his title against former WBO champion Joseph Parker next year at Co-op Live in Manchester on 30 January.

uutiset.t: NBA plans to invest 10bn euros in European arenas
uutiset.s: The NBA steps up its plans for a European league by announcing a strategy to invest at least 10bn euros in the development of basketball arenas across the continent.
